hypotheses.justification: The theorem only gets this instance through the automatic inclusion of instance-implicit section variables. The definitions in the statement do not take it: IPtHyp is a structure and ES, ptsE, galE, galO are defs, and Lean keeps only the section variables they actually use (withUsed / removeUnused in Lean core). Here is what each one uses. IPtHyp: ptSet, pointQuot, evalPair and the antipode of F ⊗[O] A, given by Mathlib's `instance : HopfAlgebra S (B ⊗[R] A)`. ES = characterClosure = flatClosure, which needs Field F, Algebra O F and CommRing (CartierDual O A); that last instance needs only IsCocomm. ptsE needs Algebra O L. galE/galO need IsScalarTower via restrictScalars. The library itself omits [IsDomain O] for gal_algebraMap. The proof only uses galE_apply (proved by rfl, so it can be replaced by `exact congrArg (fun φ => WithConv.ofConv φ e) hfix`, which closes the goal by unfolding galE), WithConv.toConv_ofConv and AlgHom.ext, none of which need it. The instance is Prop-valued, so no degenerate case changes the statement. It can be omitted independently of, or together with, the other five listed.

Same argument as for [IsDomain O]: IPtHyp, ES, ptsE and galE do not use it, so they do not take it (non-theorem declarations keep only the section variables they use). The proof only needs the rfl-lemma galE_apply, which can be replaced by unfolding, plus generic WithConv/AlgHom lemmas. The library already omits it for gal_algebraMap. It can be omitted independently.

Same argument as for [IsDomain O]. It is used only by the scoped instance instModuleFiniteES (flatClosure_finite), and nothing in this statement or proof needs that instance: forming AlgHom ↥(ES h) →ₐ[O] L and WithConv needs only Semiring/Algebra structures. The proof goes through by unfolding galE in place of galE_apply. It can be omitted independently.

Same argument as for [IsDomain O]: IPtHyp, ES, ptsE, galE and galO only use Field F, Algebra O F, Algebra F L, Algebra O L and IsScalarTower O F L, never the fraction-field property. The library explicitly omits it for gal_algebraMap. The proof only unfolds galE and uses generic lemmas. It can be omitted independently.

CartierDual O A, its CommRing instance (instCommRing needs only [IsCocomm R A]) and its Algebra O instance (instAlgebra needs only Bialgebra) do not need finiteness. Neither do dualBaseChangeLin, characterGenericFibre, characterClosure/flatClosure or the antipode of F ⊗[O] A. So none of the definitions in the statement take it, and the proof (rfl unfolding of galE, toConv_ofConv, AlgHom.ext) does not need it. It can be omitted independently.

Same argument as for [Module.Finite O A]: the CartierDual instances used here (instCommRing, instAlgebra) and the definitions characterClosure, flatClosure, IPtHyp, ptsE and galE do not need freeness. The proof only uses definitional unfolding of galE and generic WithConv/AlgHom lemmas. It can be omitted independently.
